Hold arms at origin; watching the first pickup near the watch.
Stationary observation. Demonstrator is carrying the watch first.
Wait motionless; watch is the first object being placed.
Remain stationary, remembering watch first and observing the next selection.
Wait at origin. Watch placed first; demonstrator now approaches the phone.
Hold still during demonstration. Sequence observed so far: watch, then phone pickup.
Wait at origin; demonstrator carries phone second after watch.
Stationary observation: watch first, phone second entering basket.
Wait motionless; watch and phone are in demo basket, observing third selection.
Remain stationary. Remember watch, phone; demonstrator selects doll third.
Wait without moving. Observed order: watch, phone, doll being carried third.
Stay motionless while doll is placed third; remember watch, phone, doll.
Wait at origin and observe fourth selection. Remember watch, phone, doll already demonstrated.
Remain still. Demonstrator selects cyan car fourth after watch, phone, doll.
Wait motionless; watch, phone, doll, cyan car fourth being carried. Camera remains for last.
Stay at origin. Observed watch, phone, doll, car; waiting for final camera placement and demonstrator return.
Wait motionless for final demo pickup. Memorized order: watch, phone, doll, car, then remaining camera.
Remain still as camera is picked fifth. Sequence: watch, phone, doll, car, camera; wait for demonstration to finish.
Wait for fifth object, camera, to be deposited and the demonstrator to return. Order: watch, phone, doll, car, camera.
Remain at origin until final camera release and demonstrator return. Memorized watch, phone, doll, car, camera.
Wait motionless for demonstrator to finish. Memorized order: watch, phone, doll, car, camera.
All five demo objects appear deposited; wait for demonstrator return before moving. Order watch, phone, doll, car, camera.
Demonstrator is back at origin. Begin watch-first imitation, raising and orienting left gripper toward central watch without crossing arms.
Align left gripper above first target watch with a slight inward tool tilt; keep left EE on its own side and right arm parked.
Descend slowly over watch, correcting a small image offset; keep gripper open until aligned at grasp height.
Close on the first target watch, then make a short vertical test lift to check retention visually.
Watch appears retained after lift. Raise above the basket rim and begin carrying left with the gripper closed.
Carry retained watch over the policy basket while maintaining clearance; keep other objects undisturbed.
Lower watch inside the basket footprint and open the gripper for the first placement; observe settling before the phone.
Correct malformed row; prior call moved nothing. Lift clear of deposited watch and approach phone second, right arm parked.
Position above the phone and begin a controlled descent with open fingers; watch remains in the basket.
Descend gradually to phone grasp height, with a small alignment correction based on the head view.
Close around the phone, second in the remembered sequence, and test retention with a short lift.
Phone did not follow the test lift. Reopen and reapproach slightly lower and toward its shifted center before retrying.
Retry the phone grasp at the corrected position, then lift gently; judge retention from the images.
Phone now appears retained. Lift above the basket rim and carry it left, keeping the gripper closed.
Phone slipped and lies sideways. Reopen and realign above its new center, rotating to grasp across its narrow dimension.
Descend above the sideways phone, keeping fingers open and the closing direction across its width.
Lower the fingers farther around the thin phone before closing, aiming for a secure width grasp rather than its edge.
Lift vertically from the observed contact pose with the phone gripper closed; check that the phone follows before transporting.
Phone follows the lift securely now. Raise for rim clearance and start a slow leftward transfer, maintaining closed grip.
Carry the retained phone above the basket's rear half, away from the already placed watch.
Lower the phone into the basket and release it as the second object, keeping the watch undisturbed.
Phone is released in basket after watch. Retract left clear and approach third object, doll, with the right arm in its own workspace.
Align the right gripper vertically over the doll's head and descend gradually, keeping left arm clear of the right workspace.
Lower around the doll's head, close, and make a gentle test lift for the third sequence object.
Doll appears held at the head. Lift and start carrying toward a central staging point, staying in the right workspace.
Doll slipped during lift. Reopen and realign over its shifted head, preparing a deeper grasp rather than transporting an empty gripper.
Retry the doll with a deeper head grasp, descending slowly before closing and pausing to settle.
Lift the doll vertically from the observed contact pose with closed fingers, checking retention before any sideways transfer.
Head grasp slipped again. Reopen and target the narrower blue torso for a more secure doll grasp.
Correct torso alignment from the wrist view, descend around its sides, and close for a body grasp.
Test the torso grasp with a slow vertical lift, keeping the right gripper fully closed.
Doll remains retained by its torso. Carry it to a central staging point on the right side for later left-arm pickup without crossing arms.
Set the doll down near the workspace boundary, away from the car, and release for a non-crossing left-arm regrasp.
Retract the right arm clear of the staged doll while bringing the left arm toward a torso regrasp, keeping each arm on its own side.
Align the left gripper over the staged doll's blue torso, keeping the right arm clear and the left EE on its own side.
Descend the left gripper around the staged doll's torso, making a small forward correction while keeping fingers open.
Close the left gripper securely around the doll's torso and test the regrasp with a short lift.
Raise the regrasped doll above rim height while moving gently left, maintaining a closed torso grasp.
Carry the securely retained doll left toward the policy basket with extra clearance for its hanging head.
Center the doll over the basket interior before lowering, keeping its head clear of the rim and grip closed.
Set the doll down in the basket as the third object and open the gripper, allowing it to settle before the car.
Doll is released inside basket after watch and phone. Lift clear and approach the cyan car fourth, aligning across its width.
Move above the car with open fingers and an across-width alignment, maintaining left-side arm clearance.
Descend slowly around the fourth object, cyan car, correcting the small offset before closing.
Reach the car's sides rather than just its roof, close, and begin a small test lift.
Lift the car above rim height with the gripper closed, checking that it follows before the basket transfer.
The car is retained. Carry it left above the basket rim, maintaining the closed grasp and sequence.
Center the car within the basket and lower it carefully, keeping it held until the release position is confirmed.
Release the car inside the basket as fourth, then lift the open gripper clear before approaching the final camera.
Approach the final black camera from above and turn the open gripper across its narrow dimension; four earlier objects remain in the basket.
Descend toward the final camera with open fingers, adjusting a small alignment offset from the views.
Close around the camera's narrow sides and test retention with a slow lift before the final placement.
Camera is retained. Raise it above the basket rim, then begin a careful leftward transfer with the grip closed.
Move the final camera over an open area inside the policy basket, keeping clearance and a closed grip.
Lower and release the camera inside the basket as the fifth object, preserving the earlier watch–phone–doll–car order.
Camera is released. Lift the open left gripper clear of the basket and begin returning both arms toward origin with continuous elbow-up motion.
All five objects appear inside the policy basket. Continue returning both open arms toward their original poses without disturbing either basket.
